name: Scotch Tape Runner Extra Strength, 0.31 in x 11 yd
description: A refillable Scotch double-sided tape runner with extra-strength permanent adhesive.
whySelected: Replacement for the 6061 runner: the Amazon listing bullets say photo safe, refillable, permanent, and a tape reseller says all three Scotch 055 adhesives are photo safe.
limitations: Photo-safe comes from the Amazon bullets plus one reseller (https://findtape.com/Scotch-Tape-Runner/p1749): 3M's own 055 page was not read for it, so keep attributed to the listing
Do not claim photo-safe for any other Scotch runner
benefit: Rolls on dry tape instead of wet glue, so there is nothing to wait for.
compare: Tidier than a glue stick, but permanent: you can't lift it once placed.
